global_prompt: Home router voice commands. Guest Wi-Fi: enable, turn on, or turn off the guest network. Bandwidth limit: set, limit, or cap the phone, tablet, or laptop speed to ten, twenty, fifty, or one hundred Mbps. Optimize, boost, or prioritize gaming, YouTube, Netflix, or TikTok for the PC, laptop, or smart TV. Block, stop, or prevent YouTube, TikTok, gaming, or internet access for a device. Unblock, allow, or restore access. Active sessions: who is gaming or on a video call right now, which devices are playing games, show active gaming sessions. Online devices: show all online devices, which clients are connected right now, list the devices currently using Wi-Fi. Router information: check router status, show gateway information, what is the router uptime. Wi-Fi device details: get connection details, what are the IP and status of the laptop or phone. Network: how is the network today, run a speed test, check internet connection quality, is the Wi-Fi stable.
